bar_time_coordinate.reason: The event needs the full confirmation bar. Delaying the carrier to the next bar makes the bar-indexed value available before that bar begins and avoids same-bar knowledge ambiguity.

primary_carrier_candidate.name: current_first_until_next_strict_or_reset
primary_carrier_candidate.start_rule: A decisive strict event at confirmation bar c may create a carrier beginning at bar c+1.
primary_carrier_candidate.supersession_rule: Every later strict event is newer morphology evidence and supersedes the previous carrier at that later event close, regardless of same-scale eligibility.
primary_carrier_candidate.strict_boundary_rule: If the next strict event confirms at bar d, the old carrier may still be present at the open of bar d, but it must be replaced or cleared beginning bar d+1.
primary_carrier_candidate.uncertain_rule: An eligible Uncertain strict event clears any prior decisive carrier beginning the following bar.
primary_carrier_candidate.scale_mismatch_rule: A NoStateScaleMismatch strict event clears any prior decisive carrier beginning the following bar.
primary_carrier_candidate.reset_rule: A reset at bar r clears any prior carrier beginning bar r+1; no carrier may cross epochs.
primary_carrier_candidate.end_of_data_rule: A final unresolved carrier may remain through the last observed bar but is marked right-censored and must not be interpreted as a completed duration.

hold_until_next_eligible.purpose: Measure stale continuity that would be created by skipping strict scale-mismatch events.

event_only_no_carry.purpose: Retain the F event-time baseline for comparison with the candidate carrier coverage.

fixed_bar_expiry_grid.reason: No semantically justified expiry length is frozen. If natural carrier ages are pathological, a later preregistered gate is required rather than selecting a cap from this run.

next_decision: Audit whether the current-first bar-open carrier is causally exact and semantically non-stale, and whether its natural strict/reset-bounded age distribution is acceptable. A separate post-run adjudication is required before any bar-time publication authority or any later outcome-bearing study.
